definitions.gloss: live-action adaptation; making into a live-action film or series
definitions.explanation: The process of adapting an animated work, manga, novel, or video game into a live-action film or television series with real actors.

examples.japanese: あの{漫画|まんが}が{実写化|じっしゃか}された。
examples.english: That manga was adapted into a live-action film.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}アニメの{実写化|じっしゃか}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: A live-action adaptation of the popular anime was announced.

examples.japanese: {実写化|じっしゃか}に{対|たい}してファンの{反応|はんのう}は{賛否両論|さんぴりょうろん}だった。
examples.english: Fan reactions to the live-action adaptation were mixed.

notes:
USAGE:
{実写|じっしゃ} means "real photography" or "live action" (as opposed to animation), and {化|か} means "turning into." The word is very common in entertainment news and among anime/manga fans. Can be used as a noun or with する as a verb ({実写化|じっしゃか}する).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実写化|じっしゃか}する (to make a live-action adaptation)
- {実写化|じっしゃか}が{決定|けってい}する (a live-action adaptation is confirmed)
- {実写版|じっしゃばん} (live-action version)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アニメ{化|か}: anime adaptation — adapting a work into anime, the reverse direction
- {映画化|えいがか}: film adaptation — adapting into a movie (not specifically live-action)
